scenes.title: Revaka in the mirror
scenes.rationale: The mirror conversation is a single attempted alliance with a distinct participant and outcome.
scenes.overview: Revaka offers no useful bargain; the party leaves her imprisoned.
scenes.transitionToNext: The party turns to its own plan for the dragon.

scenes.title: Preparing the dragon’s audience
scenes.rationale: Planning the offer, preparing disguises, and securing Ghesh’s summons form the continuous effort to gain an audience with the dragon.
scenes.overview: Plan the throne-for-jade offer, prepare disguises, and secure an audience through Ghesh.
scenes.transitionToNext: The escorts lead the party to the baths.

scenes.title: Audience with Ra'ghemdros
scenes.rationale: The formal audience, bargaining, and probing of the dragon’s motives occur in one encounter.
scenes.overview: Agree on the trade and discover clues to a guarded prisoner.
scenes.transitionToNext: The dragon leaves; the party investigates the villa.

scenes.title: Scouting and the jade exchange
scenes.rationale: Reconnaissance during the agreed interval, a short rest, and completion of the exchange form the preparation for entering the villa.
scenes.overview: Scout the trapped crypt, rest, and trade Apollyon’s throne for the last jade fragment.
scenes.transitionToNext: Dimension Door carries the party into the cellar.

scenes.title: The fiend beneath the villa
scenes.rationale: Locating the guardian, preparing the ambush, and the uninterrupted fight form one dungeon encounter.
scenes.overview: Ambush the fiend, rescue Delwath from the flames, and kill it.
scenes.transitionToNext: Combat ends; the party searches for the prisoner.

scenes.title: The Cloudspinner’s prison
scenes.rationale: The post-fight search and hazardous extraction form a continuous rescue operation.
scenes.overview: Find the fire records, expose the portal, and extract the crystal.
scenes.transitionToNext: The captive is secured; the party seeks somewhere safe.

scenes.title: Shelter and the final jade vision
scenes.rationale: The retreat to Dimitaur and decision to rest lead directly into the shared vision during that rest.
scenes.overview: Seek shelter with Dimitaur, rest, and see Rai’s history with the dagger.
scenes.transitionToNext: The lynx alarm wakes the rested party.

scenes.title: Allies before dawn
scenes.rationale: Capturing the scouts and welcoming the halflings develop the same overnight recruitment effort.
scenes.overview: Question scouts, welcome Milo and Tilly, and promise treasure for help.
scenes.transitionToNext: The scouts leave; work begins on the lighthouse.

scenes.title: Lighting the battlefield
scenes.rationale: Repairs, deployments, and final preparations are one defensive setup around the temple complex.
scenes.overview: Repair the lighthouse, place allies, and prepare as enemies approach.
scenes.transitionToNext: Initiative begins as the attackers close.

scenes.title: The dragon’s assault
scenes.rationale: The approaching vanguard, Ra'ghemdros’s appearance, and the ensuing melee form the opening phase of the battle before she turns on the lighthouse.
scenes.overview: Repel the flying vanguard, survive the dragon’s first breath, and fight her and the chimeras.
scenes.transitionToNext: Ra'ghemdros turns on the lighthouse to extinguish its protective light.

scenes.title: The struggle for the light
scenes.rationale: The dragon’s attack on the driftglobes shifts the battle to defending and restoring the light, culminating in Kenzo’s final blow and the return of sunrise.
scenes.overview: Fight through failing light and darkness until Kenzo restores the lighthouse and kills the dragon.
scenes.transitionToNext: With victory secured, the party heads for the hoard.

scenes.title: The hoard and the voyage home
scenes.rationale: Exploring and distributing the hoard, packing, farewells, and departure form the resolution of the island expedition.
scenes.overview: Divide the hoard, establish Dimitaur as protector, and sail back to Vindristjarna.
